title: Classic Cart Studio HOME theme
decision: D-81: the owner-selected song plays in HOME, whole and looping, On by default
provenance: Created by the Classic Cart Studio project owner (Rance9) with Suno, under the owner's own Suno subscription, and selected by the owner on 2026-11-04. It is a creative asset shipped with Classic Cart Studio; the software's GPL-3.0-or-later license does not apply to it.

native.made: the source AAC decoded once to 16-bit stereo at its own 48,000 Hz; every decoded frame kept, nothing trimmed, no fade or level change

browser.made: the source's 2,908 AAC packets copied unchanged into a new M4A without descriptive metadata (no re-encoding)
